We need to determine crimes based on facts. The case: Chen, former finance chief, involved in accepting bribes, misusing entrusted funds, etc.

Facts: He was finance chief, arranged that hospital funds be entrusted to Shanghai Dongxin Investment Management Co. He signed agreement, but the company misused funds, falsified statements. He received bribes: 20k from Jiang via Dongxin, got 10k personally. Also received 17% equity in Shanghai Kaixuan Investment Management Co (Jiang's company) and later received 93k in "return of shares" (退股费). He also got 10k returned later? Actually he got 93 million? Wait numbers: 20万元 (200k) from Jiang via Dongxin, Chen got 10万元 (100k). Then 17% equity (value unknown). Then 93万元 (930k) as return of shares. He also returned 93k? Actually he returned 93万元? He returned 93万元? The text: "2014年12月至2015年1月间，陈某先后多次收受江某某给予的退股费共计人民币93万元。" So he received 930k. Then he self-surrendered and returned 93万元? Later: "2015年3月2日，被告人陈某向检察机关投案自首，如实供述了上述受贿事实，并退赃人民币93万元。" So he returned the 93万元. Then later: "本院审理期间，被告人陈某退赃人民币10万元。" So he also returned 10k? Actually earlier he got 10万元 personally, maybe returned 10k? The numbers: He got 10万元 (100k) from bribe, later returned 10k? Not sure.

Crimes: Accepting bribes (受贿). Also embezzlement? He was responsible for supervising the entrusted funds, but the funds were misused. He may be guilty of "职务侵占" (misappropriation of public funds) or "挪用资金"? However he didn't directly embezzle; he facilitated mismanagement and accepted bribes. The misused funds were not returned; the hospital lost 1,000+ million? Actually 1,000 million? "人民币1，000余万元" = over 10 million? That's 10 million. He may be guilty of "受贿罪" and "职务侵占罪"? But the facts: He accepted bribes, and also participated in illegal fund management, causing loss to public. Could be "受贿罪" and "挪用公款罪"? However he didn't personally divert funds; he arranged the contract and oversight, but the company misused. He may be charged with "受贿罪" and "国有资产管理违规" but typical Chinese criminal law: "受贿罪" for public officials receiving bribes. Also "挪用资金" if he misused entrusted funds. The description: "上海东信投资管理有限公司接受长宁区中心医院的资金后，未按照协议将资金用于具有稳定投资收益的有价证券投资，并伪造对账单等凭证隐瞒事实。至今，长宁区中心医院尚未收回上述委托管理资金。" That is misappropriation of public funds. The official who arranged may be charged with "受贿罪" and "国有资产管理违规" but typical charge: "受贿罪" and "挪用资金罪"? Actually "挪用资金" is for state-owned enterprises? There's "挪用公款罪" for public officials who misappropriate public funds. He didn't directly misappropriate, but he allowed mismanagement. Could be "受贿罪" and "职务侵占罪"? But "职务侵占" is for public officials who use their position to illegally occupy public property. He didn't occupy; he accepted bribes.

Thus likely answer: 受贿;挪用公款 (or "职务侵占"). Look at similar examples: In earlier examples, "挪用资金" used for a travel agency manager who misappropriated travel funds. That is "挪用资金". So here similar: He arranged mismanagement of hospital funds, causing loss. Could be "挪用资金". So answer: 受贿;挪用资金.
